defect: The earlier PR added the /hud dashboard without enabling authInterrupts, so unauthorized/forbidden responses were not handled correctly.
Chat route failed to capture and flush streaming errors, causing silent outages with no Sentry events

The earlier PR ran `node scripts/turbo-local.mjs test --affected`, which selects whole packages rather than the specific changed tests, causing the pre‑push gate to execute the entire web test suite instead of a bounded set.
The smoke test incorrectly expected OAuth token revocation to always succeed (200), causing failures when refreshed tokens are revoked and the endpoint returns 400.
The earlier PR inserted light‑mode CSS variable aliases before the :root.dark block, causing the desktop token extraction to read the alias instead of the dark‑mode anchor.
The earlier PR added the Jovie wordmark as an extra resource and changed the splash HTML to load that SVG, causing missing‑asset or path errors on macOS builds.
The earlier PR introduced a new Noir Ion text ramp but did not update the desktop System‑B textSecondary color, causing a visual mismatch.
The CI script always ran the footer theme‑control proof even when the build didn't include theme switching, causing failures after the theme‑switching flag was introduced.
Components could be marked Pen‑referenceable even while a pending parity or non‑geometry decision existed, allowing invalid references.
The earlier PR removed the ContentMetricRow component but left its Storybook file, causing a dangling import/reference.
The earlier PR added smartlink screen‑cert production but failed to include the corresponding smartlink spec files in the screenshots testMatch, so those tests were never run.
runConsumerExecution always used the fixed timeout and treated all failures as usage errors, failing to distinguish hung consumers (timeouts) from genuine usage errors
The test incorrectly treated any non‑'true' string (including expression‑valued flags) as disabled, causing legitimate allowances to be flagged as violations.
The script would automatically undraft PRs that had been deliberately converted back to draft after their last push, causing parked drafts to be incorrectly marked ready.
The earlier PR added per‑lane status writes (curl to GitHub statuses) that caused race conditions and premature merge‑group ejection.

The earlier PR moved the automation registry to canon/ but did not update the lanes doctor script, which continued to read the non‑existent ops/automation/registry.jsonl, causing the registry to go unchecked.
The earlier PR hid the docked marketing header and disabled the page header offset, causing the homepage to lose its canonical header and mis‑align the hero canvas.
The test module added by the earlier PR defined a top‑level function named `setup`, which pytest treats as a setup hook and caused test collection errors.

The CI workflow ran source-read guards against only the PR head, causing guards added by the earlier PR (e.g., domain-write guard) to fail with ENOENT when the base branch added required files after the PR branched.
